routeAdjustment: Use the exact existing complex parabolic subspace and native H1 finiteness, specializing the actual cusp-potential consumer to complex coefficients. Retain only the required cusp-orbit quotient; defer denominator normal forms and other arithmetic cusp classifications until the numerical comparison consumes them. Pinned orbit counting and dual annihilator dimensions supply the finite relation bound. No external global options, attribute removals or framework commands are imported.
discharged: At every nonzero original level N, actual parabolic characters and one value per original cusp orbit inject into the exact two-term/three-term Manin relation space with one normalization coordinate. Vanishing on actual cusp stabilizers follows from the original squared-trace-four definition. The original S and ST coset actions have orders dividing two and three and are jointly connected by the integral modular-group generators. Pinned orbit counting and dual annihilator dimensions give the unconditional bound 6*dim(parabolicHoms N)+6*#cusps+3*#S-fixed-cosets+4*#ST-fixed-cosets <=12+[SL2(Z):Gamma0 N]. Native H1 finiteness is reused. No cusp potential, injectivity, orbit count, relation rank or parabolic dimension bound is assumed.
